g.text: Associational feature use by separately fitted forests; it is not a causal attribution. Panel A normalises every row to

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5865

g.text: 100% whether or not the forest predicts anything, so panel B carries the skill each row rests on: whiskers are the cross-

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5865

g.text: validated standard deviation, and an open marker flags a forest whose balanced accuracy is at chance and whose accuracy

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5865

g.text: does not beat the majority class.
